title: Residue bases and complete pullback on a common clopen partition
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $\varpi$ and residue field $k$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On the small pro-etale site of a scheme $X$, put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(R/\varpi^n)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Let $S$ be affine and weakly contractible, meaning that epimorphisms of set sheaves are surjective on $S$-sections [def-pc-scheme]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_S))$ be quotient-tower derived complete [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-derived-complete, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Its residue reduction is $K_1=K\otimes^L_{B_S}k_S$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Assume $K_1$ has bounded constructible cohomology, every cohomology sheaf is locally constant, and $K_1$ has finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. There is a finite disjoint open cover $S=\coprod_i U_i$ [def-weil-open-immersion] such that every $U_i$ is compact and weakly contractible, and every finite free $B_{U_i}$-module sheaf is projective. The completed derived pullback $M_i$ of $K$ to $U_i$ is complete [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. For each $i$ there are integers $a\leq b$ and a function $r:\mathbf Z\to\mathbf N$ such that $H^q((M_i)_1)\cong k_{U_i}^{\oplus r(q)}$ for every $q\in[a,b]$. After restriction to every object $V$ of $(U_i)_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the residue $(M_i)_1$ has Tor amplitude $[a,b]$. The finite free sheaves in the Lean statement are the existing topCellIntegralFree and topCellResidueFree [lem-sf-complete-top-residue-cell-cone]. No bounded integral complex or projective model is asserted. The empty cover and zero ranks are allowed.

source.place: Tags 09C3 (lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex) and 098F; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0946 and 08FZ. The finite residue field specialization of the simultaneous trivialization and complete restriction, before the degree induction.

proof.text: Choose the ordered Tor interval and test against the coefficient unit to obtain residue cohomology vanishing outside it. Finite constructible geometric stalks are obtained by factoring each geometric point through its constructibility stratum and using pullback-stalk comparison. Combine these finite stalks with local constancy via the pro-etale finite-model theorem and its scalar comparison to obtain finite module models on the integer interval.

Apply simultaneous clopen localization to this finite family. Retain compactness and weak contractibility. The existing projectivity conclusion for finite products of completed coefficient units applies to topCellIntegralFree by finite biproduct/coproduct comparison and ULift reindexing.

Compare completed pullback of the complete input with ordinary normalized restriction. The localization reduction isomorphism then identifies its residue with exact restriction of the original residue. Exact derived functors commute with cohomology. The slice residue free comparison supplies the displayed bases; choose the ranks and extend them by zero outside the interval. Completeness transports along the same comparison using the completion-unit criterion.

The coefficient DVR makes the residue ring a field. Exact restriction preserves the cohomological vanishing interval, and so does pullback to every local pro-etale object. The bounded-field tensor calculation turns this vanishing into the required Tor interval on every such object.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09C3 and 098F. Actual assembly uses pro-etale finite stalk/model comparisons, normalized clopen restriction, exact derived homology, and field Tor amplitude after every local pullback.

theorem residue_lisse_clopen_bases
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsAffine S)
    (hweak : (Scheme.ProEt.topology S).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1}
      (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 S)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules.{u, u} l E S))
    (hcomplete : IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S K)
    (hresidue : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E 1 (by omega) S
      ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K))
    (hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf S
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (proEtaleRingModules S (proEtaleConstantRing S
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1))) q).obj
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K)))
    (hTor : HasFiniteProEtaleTorAmplitude S
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
      ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → S.Opens),
      (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧ Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U i) (U j)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        CompactSpace (U i).toScheme ∧
        (∀ (F G : Sheaf (ProEt.topology (U i).toScheme) (Type (u + 1)))
          (f : F ⟶ G), Epi f →
            Function.Surjective (f.hom.app (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (U i).toScheme))))) ∧
        (∀ r : ℕ, Projective (topCellIntegralFree.{u} l E (U i).toScheme r)) ∧
        IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme
          ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E (U i).ι).obj K) ∧
        ∃ (a b : ℤ) (r : ℤ → ℕ), a ≤ b ∧
          (∀ q : Set.Icc a b, Nonempty
            (topCellResidueFree.{u} l E (U i).toScheme (r q.val) ≅
              (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (scalarReductionTarget.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme 0) q.val).obj
                ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme 0).obj
                  ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E (U i).ι).obj K)))) ∧
          (∀ V : (U i).toScheme.ProEt,
            HasProEtaleTorAmplitude V.left (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
              ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullback V.hom
                (proEtaleConstantRing (U i).toScheme (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1))
                (proEtaleConstantRing V.left (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1))
                (AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.StrictTower.constantRingIso
                  (ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)) V.hom)).obj
                ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme 0).obj
                  ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E (U i).ι).obj K))) a b)
